messages:
sara_support: Customer reported batch rerank returning scores that are shifted between queries. seems specific to multi-query payloads where one query has zero candidates. attaching minimal repro and logs. :eyes:

sara_support: Request we sent (sanitized):
```json
POST /v1/rerank/batch
{
  "queries": ["find best intro lines", "empty query test", "summarize product"],
  "per_query_candidate_counts": [2,0,1],
  "candidates": [
    {"id": "c1", "text": "Option A"},
    {"id": "c2", "text": "Option B"},
    {"id": "c3", "text": "Summary X"}
  ]
}
```

sara_support: API response body: 200 OK but flat scores array returned: [0.92, 0.87, 0.45] and the client library mapped them as q1->[c1=0.92,c2=0.87], q2->[], q3->[c3=0.45] — customer says c2 got associated to q3 in their app (0.87 appeared against c3).

liam_eng: Can you paste the exact server logs for that request id? also what versions of our client and server were involved?

sara_support: logs (sanitized):
```
WARN 2026-02-18 14:02:09 rerank: candidate-offsets mismatch computed_offsets=[0,2,2] flattened_length=3 expected_offsets=[0,2,3] request_id=rc_8f3
DEBUG 2026-02-18 14:02:09 rerank: building response - using flattened scores vector length=3
```

sara_support: versions: client-js v1.4.0, routed to hosted-runtime v2.11.0 (sha short: a1b2c3).

liam_eng: that mismatch log shows offset calc dropped the zero-length group when computing expected_offsets. likely the offset computation iterates candidate groups and skips empty lists in one codepath. repro looks straightforward.

todd_oncall: Immediate mitigation for customers: 1) server-side: enable strict validation header `X-RW-STRICT-VALIDATION: true` to reject malformed per_query counts (we can toggle for the tenant) 2) client-side: work around by inserting a placeholder candidate for empty groups (e.g. {id: "__placeholder__"}) so offsets stay stable.

emma_prod: Does this affect Dedicated or Private installs? any risk for auth/billing flows?

liam_eng: root cause is pure indexing bug in batching serializer; no auth/billing impact. Dedicated/private instances may also have the bug if running v2.11.0. patch prepared to preserve zero-length groups when computing offsets.

sara_support: Repro steps documented for SRE: 1) call /v1/rerank/batch with per_query_candidate_counts containing zeros 2) verify response scores vs expected mapping 3) inspect runtime logs for "candidate-offsets mismatch"

sara_support: Pasted a minimal repro curl for QA:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank/batch \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"queries":["a","b"],"per_query_candidate_counts":[1,0],"candidates":[{"id":"c1","text":"A"}]}'
```

liam_eng: will push patch that: preserves zero-count offsets, validates flattened_length == sum(per_query_candidate_counts) and logs a 400 if mismatch (instead of silently shuffling). target deploy tomorrow morning.

infra-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary -> all (rollout id=deploy_2240000520) window 02:00-03:00 UTC.

customer_rep: Notified customer about workaround (placeholder) and that a fix is scheduled. offered 2 days of credits for the disruption.

sara_support: customer confirmed workaround works for now. we'll follow up after patch deploy and close the ticket once fixed in prod. :white_check_mark:
